reports.notes: Handwritten fax (header 'SENT BY: JMART; 8017989770; JUN-14-10 5:56PM'). The cover-page signature date is struck and rewritten: the day digit '13' is crossed out with '14' written above it, giving '6-14-10'; the Date of Report box on the summary page and Schedule B both read '6-14-10', so that is the value taken. Line 1 contributions are written as a bare '1895' with no cents; transcribed exactly as printed. The Office Seeking line reads 'County Commissioner' with NO seat letter - index.csv/the county filename say 'County Commission Seat A'; the page does not corroborate the seat. Street address (38 North 950 East) is printed in full on this filing (not redacted by the county).

notes: The chunk's locator failed to find the summary page and rendered p4 (Schedule B) as a fallback; p2 is the actual SUMMARY PAGE and was rendered and read. Schedule B p4 prints 'Total Expenditures Received' 716.67, agreeing with line 2.

contributions.detail: 17 Schedule A rows on p3 sum to 500.00+100.00+25.00+500.00+25.00+25.00+100.00+100.00+100.00+50.00+50.00+25.00+100.00+25.00+100.00+20.00+50.00 = 1,895.00 exactly = the schedule's own printed page subtotal AND its printed Total Contributions Received AND the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell (Column A line 1), restated at line 4 and line 5. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints the SAME 1895 here because this is the filer's first report of the cycle (line 3 'Balance at Beginning' is a handwritten 0), so per-period and cumulative coincide — the anchor used is nevertheless the per-period Column A cell, and no cross-filing differencing was performed.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' expenditures (716.67, cents written raised) on the p2 Summary Page line 2, which is also Schedule B's printed 'Subtotal for this page' (716.67) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' (716.67)

Balance check the filer's own page closes too: line 5 subtotal 1895 - line 6 716.67 = 1178.33 = the printed line 7 'Balance at Close'.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE: 'J. Lane Henderson', Democrat, Office Seeking 'County Commissioner' (NO SEAT LETTER ON THE PAGE) — index.csv names NO candidate for this row and takes office 'County Commission Seat A' from the channel's directory path; the seat is not inferred here. Filing 1 of THREE this filer made in the 2010 cycle (this 6/15, then 10/26 and 12/02) — utah is a PER-PERIOD regime, so this report's Column A is its own increment and no figure here was derived from, or checked against, a sibling filing. 4 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election' checked, amendment = No), p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B. THE WHOLE DOCUMENT IS A FAX — every page carries the transmission header 'SENT BY: JMART; 8017989770; JUN-14-10 5:56PM; PAGE n/4' and a vertical fax artifact line down the sheet; p3 is skewed -1.8 deg, which defeats the full-width rule scan (see its measure_note). Entirely handwritten apart from the printed form. The cover's signature date is STRUCK AND REWRITTEN: '6-13-10' with the 13 crossed out and '14' written above, so the page-face date is 6-14-10, matching the p2/p3/p4 'Date of Report' boxes and the fax timestamp; the clerk's received stamp reads 'JUN 15 AM 9:16'. Both sides close EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Column A cells, and the filer's own balance ladder closes too (1895 - 716.67 = 1178.33 as printed). ONE REAL SOURCE PROPERTY worth noting: SIX rows (contributions 11-17 dated 6-15 and 7-1, expenditures 2-3) are dated AFTER this report's own 6-14-10 date, i.e. the filer wrote the seven-days-preceding-primary report to cover through the primary itself; all kept verbatim, none adjusted. PRIVACY: published unredacted — donor street addresses are legible on p3 and none was carried anywhere in this record, not even in a note.
